scope: Performance overview summary data phase only. Random isolated synthetic MySQL schema, 120 and 600 added performance indicators plus 10 existing fixture indicators; common permission state initialized before timing, one warm-up discarded, median of five sequential samples. The full-projection comparison already uses the new bounded metadata batch. Not an exact pre-batch permission benchmark, HTTP/page latency, P95 or concurrent-user acceptance.

implementation.administrator_summary: One SQL aggregate for installed permissions, canonical numeric/dot/comma/space ancestry and unambiguous active annual rows. Uses annual target/actual values only, preserves exact missing/zero/negative target handling, excludes directories and keeps code-prefix manual/automatic classification. No name or full business projections in the fast path.
implementation.compatible_fallback: Nonstandard ancestry (including Unicode/control whitespace) and duplicate active annual rows use the original projection. Never assumes MAX(year_id), merges duplicate annual values, or normalizes stored ancestry. Database without unified permission tables retains the original path.
implementation.scoped_drilldown: Requested IDs are deduplicated and read in chunks of at most 500. Uses the same original row matcher and requested year. Account, leadership and department-duty reads are reused only within one invocation; ordinary single-object canRead remains live. All list order and business projections are retained.

scope_query_evidence.limits: Mocked query-count assertion, not live SQL tracing or scan-row measurement.

compatibility_cases: Annual values differ from total values; missing annual rows stay uncertain

Unicode/control whitespace and nonnumeric ancestors retain original projection
Duplicate active annual rows retain original mapper encounter semantics

ALL, year-limited ALL, OWN, BUSINESS, LEADERSHIP and custom department/item combinations
Batch ID sets equal original individual canRead checks for 2025 and 2026
Changed department head, leadership scope, revoked function and disabled account using old token
All six performance metrics equal chart groups and drilldown totals
